title: AT “Xalq banki” tizimida uy-joy qurilishida loyihaviy moliyalashtirish segmentini ishlab chiqish hamda eskrou hisobvaraqlari mexanizmini joriy etish.

criteria.label: Ishtirokchi 4-son shaklga muvofiq texnik taklifini taqdim etishi kerak.

Ishtirokchi turar va noturar joy ob’ektlari qurilishini loyihaviy moliyalashtirish va “eskrou” hisobvarag‘i bo‘yicha operatsiyalarni amalga oshirishda O‘z.Res. va/yoki MDH davlatlaridagi tijorat banklarida diagnostika va tahlil ishlari yuzasidan tegishli xizmatlarni ko‘rsatganligi (Ishtirokchi tasdiqlash uchun shartnoma va mazkur tenderni e’lon qilish sanasidan oldin rasmiylashtirilgan QR kodli ishlarni topshirish va qabul qilish dalolatnomasi (yoki hisob faktura)ni taqdim etishi talab etiladi).

Ishtirokchi jamoasi tarkibida O‘z. Res.tijorat banklarida loyihaviy moliyalashtirish sohasida tajribaga ega mutaxassis mavjudligi (Ishtirokchi xodimining QR kodli yoki muhrlangan mehnat daftarchasi nusxasi hamda CV taqdim qilinadi).

Ishtirokchi jamoasi tarkibida MDH davlatlarida uy joy qurilish obyektlarini loyihaviy moliyalashtirish, eskrou mexanizmlarini joriy etish bo‘yicha vakolatli yoki ishchi organlarda ish tajribasiga ega bo‘lgan mutaxassisning mavjudligi (Ishtirokchi xodimining QR kodli yoki muhrlangan mehnat daftarchasining rangli skanerlangan nusxasi).

Ishtirokchi jamosida FRM (Financial Risk Manager) yoki CFA (Chartered Financial Analyst) yoki PFRM (Professional Financial Risk Manager) yoki CAIA (Chartered Alternative Investment Analyst) sertifikatiga ega xodimning mavjudligi (Ishtirokchi xodimining QR kodli yoki muhrlangan mehnat daftarchasi nusxasi hamda tegishli sertifikat nusxasi taqdim qilinadi).

subject_uz: Xalq banki tizimida uy-joy qurilishida loyihaviy moliyalashtirish segmentini ishlab chiqish va eskrou hisobvaraqlari mexanizmini joriy etish bo'yicha konsalting xizmati

reasons_uz: Qatnashish mumkin, lekin avval quyidagi shartlar bo'yicha buyurtmachidan tushuntirish so'rang.

Lot hajmiga nomutanosib tajriba yoki resurs talabi (35-bet): Mezon 4 (2 ball, jami 7 balldan) o'tish bali 4 bo'lgan sharoitda tenderdan chetlatish bilan bog'langan: 0 ball olgan ishtirokchi chetlatiladi. Talab MDH davlatlaridagi "vakolatli yoki ishchi organlar"da ishlagan mutaxassisni nazarda tutadi, bu juda tor doira; bank bilan ishlashga qodir, lekin bunday tajribasi bo'lmagan konsalting kompaniyalari ishtirok eta olmasligi mumkin. Mavzuga aloqador sabab bo'lishi mumkin, shuning uchun tekshirish tavsiya etiladi.

Raqobatni cheklashi mumkin bo'lgan boshqa shart (35-bet): Mezon 5 (1 ball) to'rtta xalqaro sertifikatdan birini talab qiladi va 0 ball olish tenderdan chetlatishga olib keladi. Mezon 1, 4 va 5 chetlatish bilan bog'langan va ularning ballari yig'indisi (1+2+1=4) o'tish baliga teng, ya'ni uchala talab ham amalda majburiy. Bank konsaltingi uchun sertifikatli xodim mantiqli bo'lishi mumkin, lekin ro'yxat tor va ekvivalent malakalar (masalan, boshqa moliyaviy-xavf sertifikatlari yoki tajriba) hisobga olinmaydi.
Buyurtmachining so'nggi 103 ta savdosida ishtirokchilar medianasi 3 ta; savdolarning 48% qismida ikki yoki undan kam ishtirokchi; eng ko'p g'olib bo'lgan yetkazib beruvchi ulushi 7%.
Diqqat: hujjatning 23 ta sahifasi mashina o'qiy olmaydigan skan, ular tahlil qilinmadi.
reasons_en: Worth bidding, but first ask the customer to clarify the conditions below.

Experience or resource demand out of proportion to the lot (page 35): Criterion 4 (2 of 7 points, with a pass mark of 4) is tied to exclusion: a bidder scoring 0 is disqualified. The requirement is for a specialist who has worked in CIS "authorised or working bodies", a very narrow pool; capable consulting firms without such a person may be shut out. A subject-related reason is conceivable, so a person should check it.

Other clause that may limit competition (page 35): Criterion 5 (1 point) requires one of four named international certificates, and a score of 0 leads to exclusion. Criteria 1, 4 and 5 all carry exclusion and their points sum (1+2+1=4) to the pass mark, so all three are effectively mandatory. A certified employee may make sense for bank consulting, but the list is narrow and equivalent qualifications or experience are not accepted.
In the customer's last 103 deals the median number of bidders was 3; 48% of deals had two or fewer bidders; the most frequent winner took 7%.
